note: KDWP state fishing lake (about 140 acres) in 366 acres of tallgrass prairie and wooded draws in the Osage Cuestas. Primitive camping only in the designated areas along the west-shore road: a lakeside gravel track with fishing-pier spits, and grassy loops with pit toilets further north. The one boat ramp is at the southwest corner by the dam. The east side past the gate is foot and bicycle traffic only. No swimming, no alcohol; shotgun and archery hunting only. --Claude
